issue_snapshot.title: Follow-ups from #49: 3 from the review, 2 from QA
issue_snapshot.body:
What the review and QA of PR #54 (for #49) found and did not fix there — filed as it merged, one ticket for the lot. ## From the review Non-blocking findings the reviewer approved despite: a statement about severity, not a judgement that they are wrong. ### The join page h1 renders 'Join {group.name}' with no overflow-wrap treatment, so an 80-character unbroken group name widens /join/[token] past a 375px viewport. Same root-cause shape as the fixed h1s, on a route with no acceptance criterion, so it is a follow-up, not a blocker. > The join page h1 renders 'Join {group.name}' with no overflow-wrap treatment, so an 80-character unbroken group name widens /join/[token] past a 375px viewport. Same root-cause shape as the fixed h1s, on a route with no acceptance criterion, so it is a follow-up, not a blocker. > > `app/join/[token]/page.tsx:84` > > Evidence: app/join/[token]/page.tsx:84:

Join {group.name}

— no break-words/truncate; grep shows the PR does not touch this file. GROUP_NAME_MAX is 80 (lib/groups/validation.ts:21), and unbroken 80-char names are exactly what set the group/members pages to 753-1136px before this fix. > > Fix: Add break-words to that h1 (block-level inside a flex-col div, so the one-class treatment used on the group-page h1 suffices) or file it as the follow-up issue; expense-screen.tsx:56,69,85 is the same shape but already tracked as a residual risk in the work order. ### The join page's buttons re-print unbounded names with no overflow-wrap treatment: `Join ${groupName}` interpolates an up-to-80-character group name and `This is me — claim ${seat.displayName}` an up-to-80-character placeholder name, both as bare text inside inline-flex Buttons. That is the same shrink-to-fit min-content shape the PR fixes on the members top back-link (which measured 703px naive), on a route with no acceptance criterion — follow-up, not a blocker. > The join page's buttons re-print unbounded names with no overflow-wrap treatment: `Join ${groupName}` interpolates an up-to-80-character group name and `This is me — claim ${seat.displayName}` an up-to-80-character placeholder name, both as bare text inside inline-flex Buttons. That is the same shrink-to-fit min-content shape the PR fixes on the members top back-link (which measured 703px naive), on a route with no acceptance criterion — follow-up, not a blocker. > > `components/groups-panels.tsx:870` > > Evidence: components/groups-panels.tsx:870 `{`Join ${groupName}`}` inside Button and :831 `{`This is me — claim ${seat.displayName}`}` inside Button; Button renders buttonClasses() = `inline-flex items-center justify-center ...` with no min-w-0 or wrapping (components/ui.tsx:171); the enclosing Card is `flex flex-col` with no overflow clipping (components/ui.tsx:327), so nothing stops the min-content floor reaching the document. GROUP_NAME_MAX and PLACEHOLDER_NAME_MAX are both 80 (lib/groups/validation.ts:21-22). > > Fix: Give the button labels the same treatment as the members back-link label — the text in its own min-w-0 break-words span, since break-words alone on the shrink-to-fit button cannot reduce its min-content floor — or file it with the join-h1 follow-up; the claim-button instance needs the same. ### The shared ConfirmStep question paragraph interpolates 80-character group and member names with no wrapping, and it renders inline in-flow on the in-scope pages once expanded: `Remove ${displayName} from "${groupName}"` on members, `Archive "${groupName}"` / rotate / disable confirms on the group page, `Leave "${groupName}"` on members. Same unbroken-name root cause; only reachable behind a click so no AC covers it — follow-up, not a blocker. > The shared ConfirmStep question paragraph interpolates 80-character group and member names with no wrapping, and it renders inline in-flow on the in-scope pages once expanded: `Remove ${displayName} from "${groupName}"` on members, `Archive "${groupName}"` / rotate / disable confirms on the group page, `Leave "${groupName}"` on members. Same unbroken-name root cause; only reachable behind a click so no AC covers it — follow-up, not a blocker. > > `components/ui.tsx:97` > > Evidence: components/ui.tsx:97-99 `

{question}

` — no break-words; instances at components/groups-panels.tsx:496 (remove), :539 (archive), :413/:426 (rotate/disable), :766 (leave); the confirm renders as an in-flow div (inline details dropdown on members, inline panels elsewhere), not a clipping dialog, so its overflow reaches the document. > > Fix: Add break-words to the ConfirmStep question

— one place covers all five instances, the same one-class treatment as the group-page h1 precedent. ## Found by QA — pre-existing PR #54 did not introduce these, which is why they did not block it. ### Expense editor with an 80-character group name scrolls horizontally at 375px (scrollWidth 1136) **Severity** minor (as judged by QA — reassess before planning). **Expected.** > The expense editor for an 80-character-named group fits the 375px viewport (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) while still naming the group in full, the same treatment this PR gave the group and members pages. **Actual.** > At a 375px viewport document.documentElement.scrollWidth is 1136px: the whole editor page scrolls sideways. The three name-bearing elements (breadcrumb link, h1, bottom Back-to link) render the 80-character name with no overflow-wrap class. **Steps to reproduce** 1. Sign up a fresh account. 2. Create a group named 'x' * 80. 3. Open /groups//expenses/new at a 375px viewport. 4. Read document.documentElement.scrollWidth and clientWidth: 1136 vs 375. **Suspected cause.** > components/expense-screen.tsx renders {groupName} bare in three places the PR did not touch: the breadcrumb Link (~line 56), the h1 title (~line 69), and the bottom Back-to (~line 85). Verified the base commit (framework root at main) carries zero break-words in this file, so the shape predates the PR — it is the residual risk the work order left 'for a follow-up if QA reproduces it'. **Reproducible:** always ### Add-seat (and rename) success line re-prints 80-character names with no wrapping (scrollWidth 676) **Severity** minor (as judged by QA — reassess before planning). **Expected.** > Adding a maximum-length placeholder seat leaves the members page fitting the 375px viewport; the success line wraps the same way the removed-member and archived notices now do. **Actual.** > The success line 'Added <80-char name>. Share the invite link so they can claim the seat.' renders in a plain

with no wrapping; document scrollWidth is 676px at a 375px viewport until the form state clears (reload/navigate). **Steps to reproduce** 1. Sign up a fresh account and create any group. 2. Open /groups//members at a 375px viewport. 3. Fill 'Add someone by name' with 'z' * 80 and submit 'Add seat'. 4. Read scrollWidth vs clientWidth while the 'Added ...' line is showing: 676 vs 375. **Suspected cause.** > The shared StateMessage (components/ui.tsx:54-64) renders success text in

with no overflow-wrap; lib/groups/actions.ts:316 interpolates the seat displayName ('Added ...') and :233 the group name ('Renamed to ...'). Base commit verified without break-words, so pre-existing — the PR fixed the two notice

s but missed this third sibling with the identical shape. **Reproducible:** always --- **Check each one still reproduces before planning it.** They were written against the PR as it stood, and a later round can have fixed one. Some may not hold up: say so and drop them rather than implementing something that was never wrong. Split this if they turn out to be unrelated. Depends on #49.

acceptance.check: With an 80-character unbroken group name, /join/[token] opened by a signed-in non-member fits a 375px viewport (scrollWidth <= clientWidth): the h1 names the group in full and wraps, and the Join and claim buttons name their group/seat in full and wrap instead of widening the page.
acceptance.how_to_verify: QA follows qa_script steps 1-2 in Chromium at 375px: account A creates the group, account B (separate context, signed-in non-member) opens /join/<token>; read scrollWidth vs clientWidth with an 80-char group name and an 80-char seat present.

acceptance.check: With 80-character unbroken group and member names, every ConfirmStep confirm expanded on the group and members pages (remove, archive, rotate, disable, leave) fits the 375px viewport: each question names its object in full and wraps.
acceptance.how_to_verify: QA follows qa_script step 3: expand each of the five confirms with max-length names and read scrollWidth vs clientWidth.

acceptance.check: The expense editor (new and edit) for an 80-character-named group fits the 375px viewport (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) while still naming the group in full in the breadcrumb, the h1, the subtitle, and the bottom Back-to link; a 200-character unbroken expense description in the edit h1 wraps the same way; the multi-payer Remove-per-row button with an 80-character member name wraps the same way.
acceptance.how_to_verify: QA follows qa_script steps 4-6: /expenses/new with an 80-char group name in both single-payer and several-payers states, and /expenses/[id]/edit with a 200-char unbroken description; scrollWidth vs clientWidth at 375px.

acceptance.check: Adding a maximum-length placeholder seat (and renaming to a maximum-length group name) leaves the members page fitting the 375px viewport: the shared StateMessage success line names the seat/group in full and wraps.
acceptance.how_to_verify: QA follows qa_script step 7: add a z*80 seat and rename to x*80, read scrollWidth vs clientWidth while each success line is showing.

acceptance.check: Unit tests pin the wrapping treatment on every touched element and pin that short names render unchanged; typecheck, test:ci, and build are green.
acceptance.how_to_verify: CI runs npm run typecheck, npm run test:ci (including the new components/overflow-wrap.test.ts cases, which reach the claim button through JoinPanel with a seats prop and the payer row through the exported ExpenseEditor), and npm run build.

acceptance.check: The /activity empty state for an 80-character-named group fits the 375px viewport: the Open-group action names the group in full and wraps.
acceptance.how_to_verify: QA follows qa_script step 8: fresh account, create an x*80 group (no activity yet), open /activity with the default all filter, read scrollWidth vs clientWidth.

alternatives_considered.approach: Truncate-with-ellipsis plus title on the headings, buttons, confirms, and notices instead of wrapping.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: ui.md reserves truncate for list rows; a heading, a Join button, or a confirm question truncated to an ellipsis stops saying which group or seat it acts on. PR #54 set the precedent the other way: rows truncate, headings and sentences that name a group or person wrap.

alternatives_considered.approach: Add break-words at each ConfirmStep and StateMessage call site instead of in the shared components.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because:
The call sites are byte-identical symptoms of one shared

each; per-site classes are N chances for the next caller to miss one. The one-place fix in components/ui.tsx covers the settle-up and expense delete confirms and notices too, which interpolate names with the same shape.

alternatives_considered.approach: Clip with max-width/overflow-hidden on the buttons and notices so nothing can widen the page.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Clipping hides the name it is supposed to confirm (which seat am I claiming, what was added), trading a layout defect for a trust defect in a money app. Wrapping keeps the full name legible.

alternatives_considered.approach: Leave the expense-editor Remove-per-payer button and the /activity empty-state link out of this ticket as further follow-ups.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Both are the identical unbroken-name root cause on routes this work already touches (editor) or reaches in three steps (activity); each fix is one class in the same idiom, and deferring them would leave AC-3's page-level clause false and the out_of_scope QA-pass claim covering a route QA never visits.

validated_work_order.approach:
Apply the PR #54 overflow-wrap idiom to the five reported spots plus the two the critique proved are the same defect: block-level headings and sentences get break-words; anything that is a flex item gets a min-w-0 box of its own plus break-words, because a flex item's automatic minimum size is its min-content width and overflow-wrap alone cannot reduce it. Specifically: the join h1 gains break-words (block in a flex-col div, the group-page h1 precedent); the Join and claim button labels move into min-w-0 break-words spans with min-w-0 appended (not replacing ml-auto) on the buttons, the spans inside children so the pending label path is untouched; the shared ConfirmStep question

and StateMessage

gain min-w-0 break-words once, covering all confirms and notices; ExpenseScreen gains break-words on h1/subtitle/bottom Back-to paragraph and min-w-0 break-words on the group-crumb

  • with an in-file comment recording the breadcrumb decision (this crumb is a link naming the group so it follows the members back-link wrapping precedent, while the current-page crumb beside it keeps truncate as a location); the expense-editor multi-payer Remove button gets the same label-span plus min-w-0 treatment; the /activity empty-state Open-group link gains break-words. QA drives two accounts throughout because the join page redirects members and signed-out visitors. No copy, markup (beyond the three button-label spans), or behaviour change; rows and the shell keep truncate.
assumptions: Each of the five findings still reproduces on main: verified by reading the current code (no break-words/min-w-0 at any cited site), not by driving a browser, so reproduced is false and QA re-measures scrollWidth.
Tailwind break-words (overflow-wrap:break-word) plus min-w-0 behaves here as it did in PR #54, which QA verified at 375px in Chromium.
AppShell place={groupName} needs no change: it already renders truncate with the full value in title (components/app-shell.tsx:88-95).

GROUP_NAME_MAX and PLACEHOLDER_NAME_MAX are both 80 and DESCRIPTION_MAX is 200 (lib/groups/validation.ts:21-22, lib/expenses/validation.ts:77); the 200-char unbroken description is the widest string the edit h1 can hold.
plan/brief.md records no decisions for this issue, so no critique finding contradicts a binding decision.

The /activity empty-state overflow mechanism (unbroken run inside a flex-col items-start EmptyState action) is read from code, not measured in a browser; the one-class fix is a no-op on normal text, and QA step 8 measures it either way.
validated_work_order.confidence_rationale: Root cause is verified in code at every cited site, all callers of the two shared components were checked, and six of the seven code edits repeat the PR #54 idiom verbatim in identical layout contexts already proven at 375/375. What keeps this out of the 90s: no browser was driven, so the post-fix scrollWidth numbers (especially the claim button's two-level min-w-0 in a flex-wrap row and the activity empty-state column-context overflow) are QA-measured, not proven.
validated_work_order.debate_summary: The critique was right on all five findings and they are all folded in: (1) the qa_script could never reach /join as written because the creator is a member and members are redirected (verified at app/join/[token]/page.tsx:55-76) — the script now uses two accounts, which is also the only way to exercise the claim button; (2) the expense-editor several-payers Remove button is the identical shrink-to-fit shape inside a flex-wrap row (verified at components/expense-editor.tsx:484/543-551) and AC-3's page-level clause would have read green while the page still scrolled — components/expense-editor.tsx is now a touched file with a test case and a QA step that enters the progressive-disclosure state; (3) the /activity empty-state Open-group link is the same shape on a route the proposal's QA pass did not cover — app/activity/page.tsx is now a touched file with AC-6 and a QA step instead of relying on the touched-routes pass; (4) ClaimSeatForm is not exported (verified at components/groups-panels.tsx:801), so the test now reaches the claim button through the exported JoinPanel with a seats prop, matching how the existing long-name test reaches internals through MembersScreen; (5) the expense breadcrumb wrap-vs-truncate choice was unrecorded against the repo's own crumb-truncates precedent — the work order now decides it explicitly (group link wraps per the back-link precedent, current-page crumb keeps truncate) and requires the rationale as an in-file comment. Partially dismissed: the two fixed-dialog ConfirmStep instances (settle delete, expense delete) get no criterion because position:fixed dialogs cannot widen the document — they still benefit from the shared fix and are pinned by the shared-component unit test. Nothing was silently ignored.
evidence: app/join/[token]/page.tsx:84 renders Join {group.name} in a bare h1 with no wrapping class; :55-61 selects the viewer's membership and :76 redirects members to the group page while :73-75 redirects signed-out visitors to /signin, so a single creator account can never see the join page.

components/ui.tsx:97-99 ConfirmStep question

and :54-64 StateMessage

carry no overflow-wrap; ConfirmStep instances interpolating 80-char names at groups-panels.tsx:496, :539, :413, :426, :766; StateMessage success strings at lib/groups/actions.ts:233 and :316.

qa_script: Sign up account A, create a group named x*80, and copy its invite link. In a separate browser context sign up account B and open /join/<token> at a 375px viewport: read scrollWidth vs clientWidth (expect <=375), and confirm the h1 and the Join button show their full names wrapped over several lines.

As A, add a seat named z*80 from the members page (plus one seat matching B's own display name, which renders the Looks-like-you Badge); as B, reload the join page at 375px: both claim buttons wrap with their full names and scrollWidth still fits.

With 80-character group and member names, expand each ConfirmStep on the group and members pages (remove, archive, rotate, disable, leave): each question shows its full names wrapped and the page still fits 375px.
Open /groups/<id>/expenses/new for the 80-char group at 375px: scrollWidth <= clientWidth with the breadcrumb, h1, subtitle, and bottom Back-to link all naming the group in full.

On the same new-expense page with a z*80 seat present, switch to Paid by several people and press Add another payer so a Remove z*80 button renders: the button label wraps and scrollWidth still fits 375px.
Open /groups/<id>/expenses/<expId>/edit for an expense whose description is 200 unbroken characters at 375px: the h1 wraps and the page fits.

On /groups/<id>/members at 375px, add a seat named z*80 and rename the group to x*80: while each success line shows (Added ..., Renamed to ...), scrollWidth <= clientWidth and the sentence is fully legible.
As a fresh account with one x*80 group and no activity yet, open /activity with the default all filter at 375px: the Open x*80 action wraps and scrollWidth <= clientWidth.
Reload each touched route and confirm zero console errors and short names render exactly as before.
residual_risks: If the claim button's flex-wrap row context needs more than the two-level min-w-0 treatment, QA step 1-2 scrollWidth reads will show it; the fallback is max-w-full on that Button, not a redesign.
Native <select> controls populated with 80-char names (member filter, payer selects) scroll internally rather than widening the document; QA steps re-confirm this on the touched routes.
The /activity empty-state overflow was read from code, not measured in a browser; if QA step 8 shows it never overflowed, the one-class addition is still a harmless no-op on normal text.
risks: StateMessage and ConfirmStep are shared by the settle-up and expense-editor flows too; the added classes only affect unbreakable strings (overflow-wrap is a no-op on normal text), and the unit test pins short names unchanged.

Button label spans change the buttons' DOM (text node becomes a span inside children, so the pending-label path is untouched); no selector or test targets the bare text node (selectors key on role/labels), and the accessible name is unchanged.

validated_work_order.understanding: Issue #55 collects five leftover instances of one root cause PR #54 proved on the group and members pages: an up-to-80-character unbroken group or seat name (up to 200 for expense descriptions) rendered with no overflow-wrap treatment becomes a single unbreakable line that sets the document width at a 375px viewport. The five spots are the join-page h1, the join/claim buttons, the shared ConfirmStep question paragraph, the name-bearing elements of the expense screen, and the shared StateMessage success line. The critique proved two further instances of the same defect the proposal missed (the expense-editor multi-payer Remove button, the /activity empty-state Open-group link), a broken QA path (the join page redirects members and signed-out visitors, so one creator account can never see it), an unexported test target (ClaimSeatForm), and an unrecorded breadcrumb decision. The fix repeats the #54 idiom at each spot — wrap in place, never truncate, since headings, buttons, confirms, and notices must keep naming their object in full — with min-w-0 wherever a flex container holds the string.
unknowns: The exact post-fix scrollWidth numbers, which only a browser pass can produce (QA measures them in every AC).
Whether any further unbounded string on these routes (e.g. viewer display names in subtitles) exceeds 80 characters; wrapping covers whatever length arrives.
